description: Source code implementing Qpack instruction definitions, validation, and related functions for HTTP/3 header compression.

classes.name: QpackInstructionWithValues
classes.description: Represents a Qpack instruction with associated values for encoding.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::InsertWithNameReference
methods.description: Creates an instruction with a name reference, static or dynamic, and a value.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::InsertWithoutNameReference
methods.description: Creates an instruction with a literal name and value.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::Duplicate
methods.description: Creates a duplicate instruction with a specified index.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::SetDynamicTableCapacity
methods.description: Creates an instruction to set dynamic table capacity.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::InsertCountIncrement
methods.description: Creates an instruction to increment insert count.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::Prefix
methods.description: Creates a prefix instruction with insert count.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::IndexedHeaderField
methods.description: Creates an indexed header field instruction, static or dynamic.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::LiteralHeaderFieldNameReference
methods.description: Creates a literal header field with name reference.

methods.name: QpackInstructionWithValues::LiteralHeaderField
methods.description: Creates a literal header field with literal name and value.
